units.source_text: 话分两头，且说柏木卫门督现已兼任中纳言，圣眷优厚，变了个红人。

en.t: Meanwhile, Kashiwagi, the Captain of the Gate Guards, was now also serving as Middle Counselor, enjoyed the emperor's special favor, and had become a rising favorite.

units.source_text: 他虽然官位晋升，但对三公主的恋爱终于失败，心中不胜悲伤。

en.t: Although his rank had risen, his love for the Third Princess had ended in failure, and his heart was overwhelmed with grief.

units.source_text: 结果娶得了三公主的姐姐二公主，即落叶公主。

en.t: In the end, he had married the Third Princess's elder sister, the Second Princess, known as Princess Ochiba.

units.source_text: 落叶公主是身份低微的更衣所生，因此柏木对她怀有几分轻蔑之心。

en.t: Princess Ochiba had been born to a lower-ranking court lady, so Kashiwagi felt a certain contempt for her.

units.source_text: 落叶公主的品貌，与一般人比较起来，其实优越得多。

en.t: In truth, Princess Ochiba's character and appearance were far superior to those of ordinary people.

units.source_text: 然而柏木的心总是怀念最初的恋人三公主。

en.t: Yet Kashiwagi's heart always longed for his first beloved, the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 他觉得落叶公主好比“不能慰我情”的“姨舍山”的月亮，因此对待她很冷淡，但求表面好看而已。

en.t: To him, Princess Ochiba was like the moon over Obasute Mountain that could not console his longing, and so he treated her coldly, doing only enough to keep up appearances.

units.source_text: 他心底里始终不忘记三公主。

en.t: Deep in his heart, he never forgot the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 从前替他传言送信的侍女小侍从，是三公主的乳母侍从的女儿。

en.t: The maid Ko Jijū, who had once carried messages and letters for him, was the daughter of Jijū, the Third Princess's nurse.

units.source_text: 这乳母的姐姐是柏木的乳母。

en.t: That nurse's elder sister had been Kashiwagi's own nurse.

units.source_text: 因有这关系，柏木早就详悉三公主的种种情况。

en.t: Because of this connection, Kashiwagi had long known many details about the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 例如她从小长得如何漂亮，朱雀院如何宠爱她，他都知道。

en.t: For example, he knew how beautiful she had been since childhood and how dearly Suzaku-in loved her.

units.source_text: 这便是他刻骨相思的起因。

en.t: This was the origin of the longing that had sunk into his very bones.

units.source_text: 柏木推想：此时源氏陪紫夫人住在二条院，六条院里人很少了。

en.t: Kashiwagi guessed that Genji was now staying with Lady Murasaki at Nijō, leaving very few people at Rokujō.

units.source_text: 便邀小侍从到家里来，和她恳切商谈：“我自昔年以来，对三公主就想念得要命。

en.t: He therefore invited Ko Jijū to his house and spoke to her earnestly: "For many years I have longed desperately for the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 全靠有你这个好人儿传达，我能知道公主种种情况，公主也能知道我相思之苦。

en.t: Thanks entirely to your kind help in carrying messages, I was able to learn about the princess, and she too could know the suffering of my love.

units.source_text: 我以为事在必成，想不到终于落空，真教我伤心之极啊！

en.t: I thought the matter was certain to succeed, but in the end it came to nothing, and it has left me heartbroken beyond measure.

units.source_text: 有人报告朱雀院说：‘源氏家里有许多夫人，三公主屈居人下，夜夜抱影独眠，不胜寂寥之苦。’

en.t: Someone reported to Suzaku-in, 'Genji has many ladies in his household, and the Third Princess is forced into a lesser place, sleeping alone night after night in unbearable loneliness.'

units.source_text: 朱雀院听了这话，也有些儿后悔，曾经说道：‘既然要在臣下中选择可靠的女婿，应该选个能够真心照顾公主的人。’

en.t: When Suzaku-in heard this, he felt some regret and once said, 'If I was to choose a trustworthy son-in-law from among my subjects, I should have chosen someone who would truly care for the princess.'

units.source_text: 又有人告诉我：朱雀院曾说二公主嫁了我反而安稳，可保终身幸福。

en.t: Someone also told me that Suzaku-in once said the Second Princess was actually secure in marrying me and could be happy for life.

units.source_text: 我很同情三公主，常常替她惋惜，心中好不悲伤啊！

en.t: I feel deeply sorry for the Third Princess and often grieve on her behalf, and my heart is terribly sad.

units.source_text: 照理说来，姐妹两人同是公主，其实却完全是另一回事。”说着连声叹息。

en.t: In principle, the two sisters are both princesses, but in reality it is an entirely different matter." As he spoke, he sighed again and again.

units.source_text: 小侍从答道：“啊呀，真是无法无天啊！

en.t: Ko Jijū replied, "Good heavens, how outrageous!

units.source_text: 娶得了二公主，还说是另一回事，又想三公主。

en.t: You have married the Second Princess, yet you say that is a different matter and still think of the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 你的欲壑真是无底洞啊！”

en.t: Your desires truly are a bottomless pit!"

units.source_text: 柏木笑道：“做人总是这样的呀！

en.t: Kashiwagi laughed and said, "That is simply how people are.

units.source_text: 我从前冒昧向三公主求婚，朱雀院和今上都知道。

en.t: Long ago I had the audacity to ask for the Third Princess's hand, and both Suzaku-in and the present emperor knew of it.

units.source_text: 而且朱雀院有一次曾经说过：‘有什么不好呢？

en.t: Moreover, Suzaku-in once said, 'What would be wrong with it?

units.source_text: 就许了他吧。’

en.t: Let him have her.'

units.source_text: 哎呀，那时你倘能多出点力，事情就成功了。”

en.t: Ah, if only you had put in a little more effort then, the matter would have succeeded."

units.source_text: 小侍从答道：“这件事实在困难。

en.t: Ko Jijū answered, "That matter was truly difficult.

units.source_text: 人生在世，主要是靠所谓前世宿缘的呀！

en.t: A person's life in this world depends mainly on what is called karmic ties from a former life.

units.source_text: 源氏主君自己开口、恳切要求的时候，你难道有资格站出来和他竞争么？

en.t: When Lord Genji himself spoke up and earnestly asked for her, did you really have the standing to come forward and compete with him?

units.source_text: 现在你固然已经升官晋爵，袍色也变成深紫了，可是当时……”

en.t: Now, of course, you have risen in office and rank, and the color of your robe has become deep purple, but at that time..."

units.source_text: 柏木毫无办法，觉得对于这个能言善辩的小侍从，再没有话可说了。

en.t: Kashiwagi was helpless and felt he had nothing more to say to this eloquent Ko Jijū.

units.source_text: 但终于言道：“好了好了，过去的事，不必重提了吧！

en.t: But at last he said, "All right, all right, there is no need to bring up the past again.

units.source_text: 不过，现在机会难得，你总得想个法子，让我近得她身，把我的心事略微诉说一点吧。

en.t: Still, this opportunity is rare, so you must find some way to let me come near her and say just a little of what is in my heart.

units.source_text: 至于分外之事——好，你且看吧——的确很可怕，我决不会动这念头。”

en.t: As for anything beyond that, well, just watch me; it is truly frightening, and I will never entertain such a thought."

units.source_text: 小侍从说：“除了诉说之外，岂可更有分外之事？

en.t: Ko Jijū said, "Besides speaking to her, how could there possibly be anything beyond that?

units.source_text: 你真是存心不良啊！

en.t: You truly have wicked intentions.

units.source_text: 我今天后悔到这里来了。”她严词拒绝。

en.t: I regret coming here today." She refused him in stern words.

units.source_text: 柏木说：“哎呀，这话好难听啊！

en.t: Kashiwagi said, "Ah, what harsh words!

units.source_text: 你看得太认真了。

en.t: You are taking this far too seriously.

units.source_text: 世间男女因缘原是变化莫测的。

en.t: The bonds between men and women in this world are by nature unpredictable and ever changing.

units.source_text: 即使是女御或皇后，亦难免有此种事情，例子不是没有的。

en.t: Even imperial consorts or empresses cannot always avoid such things; there are examples enough.

units.source_text: 何况三公主境遇如此！

en.t: How much more so when the Third Princess is in such circumstances!

units.source_text: 照理想来，尊荣幸福无有比伦，岂知内心痛苦甚多。

en.t: One would think she enjoys unmatched honor and happiness, yet who knows how much pain she bears within?

units.source_text: 朱雀院于许多公主之中，特别钟爱这三公主。

en.t: Among all his princesses, Suzaku-in especially cherished this Third Princess.

units.source_text: 如今教她与许多身份低微的妇人为伍，她心中定多愤懑。

en.t: Now that she is made to live among many women of lower status, she must surely feel much resentment in her heart.

units.source_text: 内情我都知道呢。

en.t: I know all the circumstances behind it.

units.source_text: 世事原是变化无常的，你不要固执己见，讲这些不通权变的话！”

en.t: Worldly affairs are by nature changeable and uncertain, so do not cling stubbornly to your own view and speak such inflexible words!"

units.source_text: 小侍从答道：“照你说来，难道公主为了不肯屈居人下，可以改嫁一个更好的人么？

en.t: Ko Jijū answered, "According to what you say, could the princess remarry someone better simply because she refuses to be placed beneath others?

units.source_text: 她和源氏主君的关系，与世间普通夫妻不同。

en.t: Her relationship with Lord Genji is not like that of an ordinary married couple in the world.

units.source_text: 只因公主没有适当的保护人，与其叫她无依无靠地住在家里，不如把她让与源氏主君，请他代父母保护她。

en.t: Because the princess had no suitable protector, rather than leave her at home without anyone to rely on, she was entrusted to Lord Genji so that he might protect her in place of her parents.

units.source_text: 这一点他们两人也互相会意。

en.t: On this point, the two of them understand each other.

units.source_text: 你不可信口侮蔑人家呀！”她终于生起气来。

en.t: You must not slander people so carelessly!" At last she became angry.

units.source_text: 柏木便用种种好话安慰她。

en.t: Kashiwagi then soothed her with all sorts of gentle words.

units.source_text: 后来说道：“老实说，我也早就想到：公主看惯了源氏主君那样优美无比的风姿，决不会赏识我这个微贱之人的丑陋相貌。

en.t: Afterward he said, "To be honest, I too have long thought that the princess, accustomed to Lord Genji's incomparable grace and beauty, would never appreciate the ugly appearance of someone as lowly as I am.

units.source_text: 但我所指望的，只是隔着屏帏向她说一句心中的话，这总不会使公主有所损害吧。

en.t: But all I hope for is to say one word from my heart to her from behind a screen; surely that would do the princess no harm.

units.source_text: 对神佛诉说心事，也是无罪的呀！”

en.t: Even telling one's heart to the gods and Buddhas is no sin!"

units.source_text: 他就向她郑重宣誓，保证不做非礼之行。

en.t: He then solemnly swore to her and promised that he would do nothing improper.

units.source_text: 小侍从起初认为此事不成体统，拒绝他的要求。

en.t: At first Ko Jijū thought the matter was improper and refused his request.

units.source_text: 但青年人毕竟意志薄弱，看见他如此苦苦哀求，觉得不忍坚拒，便对他说：“要有适当机会，才可替你设法。

en.t: But young people are weak-willed after all, and seeing him plead so bitterly, she felt unable to refuse him firmly and said, "Only if there is a suitable opportunity can I try to arrange something for you.

units.source_text: 不过，大臣不在家的晚上，公主帐外总有许多人伺候，座旁亦必有亲信侍女陪伴，要找机会实在是很不容易的。”

en.t: However, even on nights when the minister is away, many people are always in attendance outside the princess's curtains, and trusted gentlewomen are sure to sit beside her, so finding an opportunity is truly not easy."
